senses.gloss:
कव् कव्, cl. 1. A. कवते, -वितुम्, to de-
scribe (as a poet); to paint; to picture,
colour; [cf. कब्.]

कव 1. कव, a form substituted for क, का,
and 1. कु, to express deterioration or deficiency.
—क-
व-पथ, अस्, m., Ved. a bad way.
—कवाग्नि (˚व-
अग्˚), इस्, m. a little fire.
—कवोष्ण (˚व-उष्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, slightly warm, tepid; (अम्), n. slight warmth.

2. कव in अ-कव and कवासख; [cf. कवत्नु
and कवारि.]
काव काव, अम्, n. (fr. कवि), N. of a Sāman.

कवक कवक, अम्, n. a fungus, a mush-
room; a mouthful.

कवच कवच, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be fr.
3. कु), armour, mail, a coat of mail, a cuirass; the
jacket of a boy; an amulet, a charm, the mystical
syllable हुम् or हूम्, forming part of a Mantra and
considered as a preservative like armour; it is also
inscribed on a birch leaf &c. and worn as an amulet,
being carried about the person as a charm (this is
the probable meaning in the titles दुर्गा-कवच,
सूर्यक्˚, शिवक्˚, भवानीक्˚, &c.); a drum used in
battle, a kettle-drum; the tree Hibiscus Populneoides.
—कवच-पत्त्र, अम्, n. the leaf of a birch tree;
[cf. भूर्ज-पत्त्र.]
—कवच-पाश, अस्, m., Ved.
the fastening of a cuirass or coat of mail.
—कवच-
हर, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, wearing armour or mail, or a
jacket; wearing amulets; (अस्), m. a boy, a child.
कवचित, अस्, आ, अम्, dressed in armour.

कवचिन्, ई, इनी, इ, dressed in armour; (ई), m. an
epithet of Śiva; N. of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.

कवटी कवटी, f. the leaf or panel of a door;
[cf. कवाट.]

कवड कवड, अस्, m. water &c. for washing
the mouth; [cf. कवल.]

कवत्नु कवत्नु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. 1. कु), Ved. self-
ish, stingy; (Sāy.) a bad deed.

कवन कवन, अम्, n. water; (अस्), m., N.
of a son of Śṛṅgin.

कवन्तक कवन्तक, अस्, m., N. of a man;
(आस्), m. pl. the descendants of this man.

कवन्ध कवन्ध and कवन्धिन्. See क-
बन्ध and कबन्धिन्.
कवपथ कव-पथ. See under 1. कव.

कवयी कवयी, f. the fish Cojus Cobojus
(commonly called Kavay or Kay), remarkable for
going by land from one spot to another; [cf. क-
विका.]

कवर कवर, अस्, आ or ई (?), अम् (fr. rt. 3. कु),
mixed, intermingled, blended; set, inlaid; (अस्), m.
a lecturer; (अस्, ई), m. f. (according to some also n.)
a braid or fillet of hair; (अस्, अम्), m. n. salt; sour-
ness or acidity; (आ), f. the plant Ocimum Gratissi-
mum; (ई), f. the leaf of the Asa Fœtida plant,
Hiṅgupattrī.
—कवर-पुच्छी, f. having a twisted
tail or one which resembles a braid.
—कवरी-भर
or कवरी-भार, अस्, m. a fine head of hair.
—क-
वरी-भृत्, त्, त्, त्, wearing a fillet of hair.

कवार कवार, अस्, m. the bird Tantalus
Falcinellus; (अम्), n. a lotus; [cf. कवेल.]

कावार कावार (का-आव्˚), अम्, n. the aquatic
plant Vallisneria; (ई), f. an umbrella or chattar,
especially one without a stick and worn like a broad-
brimmed hat.

कवरकी कवरकी, f. a captive, a prisoner;
[cf. वन्दि.]

कवल कवल, अस्, अम्, m. n. (fr. 3. कु?), a
mouthful; an astringent wash for cleansing the mouth,
a gargle; a kind of fish, commonly called Baliya; [cf.
[]
Hib. caomhna, caomhnadh, ‘food, nourishment.’]
—कवल-प्रस्थ, अस्, m., N. of a town.

कवलिका, f. a piece of cloth over a sore or wound,
a bandage.

कवलित, अस्, आ, अम्, swallowed as a mouthful,
eaten.

कवष कवष, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. according to
Mahīdhara either ‘sounding, creaking,’ or ‘pierced’
(said of the leaves of a door); (अस्), m. a shield; N.
of a man, son of Ilūṣa or Ailūṣī, author of several
hymns of the Ṛg-veda; N. of a Muni; N. of the
author of a Dharma-śāstra.

कवस कवस, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 3. कु),
armour, a coat of mail; a prickly shrub.

कावष कावष, अम्, n. (fr. कवष), N. of
a Sāman.

कवाट कवाट, अस्, ई, अम्, m. f. n. (for क-
पाट), the leaf or panel of a door; a door; (at the
end of a compound कवाटक; cf. कवटी.)
—क-
वाट-घ्न, अस्, m. breaking the door, a thief; [cf.
कपाट-घ्न.]
—कवाट-वक्र, अम्, n., N. of a
plant; commonly called कवाटवेटु; or according
to others कवाडवेण्टुया.

कावट कावट, अम्, n., N. of a district con-
taining 100 Grāmas; [cf. कर्वट.]

कवारि कवारि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. selfish, stingy;
[cf. अ-कवारि, अ-कव, कवत्नु.]

कवा-सख, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. a companion of the
selfish man, selfish.

कवि कवि, इस्, इस् or ई, इ (said to be fr. rt. 3.
कु; but perhaps related to आकूत, आकूति), sensible,
intelligent, prudent, clever, wise, learned; a thinker,
a wise man, a sage, an intelligent man; (metaphoric-
ally) epithet of the gates of the sacrificial enclosure;
epithet of the Ṛbhus (as skilful in contrivance);
epithet of the old sages or patriarchs, now as spirits
surrounding the sun; epithet of the gods, especially
of Agni, Indra, Varuṇa, the Maruts, and Ādityas;
epithet of the Soma priest &c.; (इस्), m. a poet,
especially one who composes artificial poems; N.
of a man, according to some genealogies a son of
Brahmā, according to others a son of Bhṛgu and
father of Śukra; epithet of Śukra, the regent of the
planet Venus and preceptor of the demons; the sons
of several Manus are also called Kavis; N. of a son of
Kauśika and pupil of Garga; also a son of Ṛṣabha;
N. of Vālmīki, the inventor of poesy and author of
the Rāmāyaṇa; the sun ?; (इस् or ई), f. the bit of
a bridle or the reins altogether; a ladle.
—कवि-
कण्ठ-हार, अस्, m. ‘the ornament of the neck of
a poet,’ title of a work on rhetoric.
—कवि-कल्प-
द्रुम, अस्, m. title of a collection of roots written
in verse by Vopadeva.
—कवि-कल्प-लता, f. title of
a work on rhetoric by Devendra.
—कवि-क्रतु, उस्,
उस्, उ, Ved. having wise designs, wise; (Sāy.) one
who possesses wisdom or sacrifices.
—कवि-चन्द्र,
अस्, m. the son of Karṇa-pūra and father of Kavi-
vallabha, author of the Kāvya-candrikā; the author
of the Dhātu-candrikā; the author of the Ratnāvalī;
the author of the Rāmacandra-campū; the author
of the Śānti-candrikā; the author of a grammar
called Sārala-harī; the author of a book named
Stavāvalī.
—कवि-च्छद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. delighting
in wise men; (Sāy.) causing pleasure to the wise.
—कवि-ज्येष्ठ, अस्, m. an epithet of Vālmīki,
the author of the Rāmāyaṇa, ‘the oldest of poets.’
—कवि-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, wisest.
—कवि-तर,
अस्, आ, अम्, wiser.
—कवि-ता, f. poesy, poetic style
or composition.
—कवितामृत-कूप (˚ता-अम्˚),
अस्, m. title of a modern collection of verses, ‘a well
of nectar of poetry.’
—कविता-वेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, un-
derstanding poesy, wise, learned, a poet, a genius.
—कवि-त्व, अम्, n. wisdom; poesy.
—कवि-त्वन,
अम्, n., Ved. wisdom.
—कवित्व-रत्नाकर, अस्,
m. title of a modern work on rhetoric.
—कवि-
दर्पण, N. of a work by Raghu.
—कवि-पुत्र,
अस्, m., N. of a dramatic author.
—कवि-प्रशस्त,
अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. highly esteemed or praised by sages.
—कवि-प्रिया, f. a work on rhetoric by Keśava-
[]
dāsa.
—कवि-भट्ट, अस्, m., N. of a poet.
—कवि-
भूम, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—कवि-भूषण,
अस्, m. the son of Kavi-candra.
—कवि-रथ, अस्,
m., N. of a prince, a son of Citra-ratha.
—कवि-
रहस्य, अम्, n. ‘the secret of the learned,’ title
of a collection of roots by Halāyudha.
—कवि-राज,
अस्, m. king of the poets, N. of the author of the
Rāghavapāṇḍavīya.
—कवि-रामायण, अस्, m. an
epithet of Vālmīki, the author of the Rāmāyaṇa,
(an incorrect form for रामायण-कवि.)
—कवि-
लासिका or कवि-लाशिका, f. (?) a kind of lute.
—कवि-
वल्लभ, अस्, m., N. of the son of Kavi-candra.
—कवि-वृध, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. prospering the
wise.
—कवि-शस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. praised by wise
men.
—कवीश्वर (˚वि-ईश्˚), अस्, m. a king of poets;
N. of a poet.

कविक, अम्, n. the bit of a bridle or the reins
altogether; (आ), f. the bit of a bridle; N. of a flower, =
केविकापुष्य; a sort of fish, commonly called Kay.
कवितृ, ता, त्री, तृ (?), wise, learned.
कविय, अस्, अम्, m. n. the bit of a bridle or the reins.

1. कवीय, nom. P., Ved. कवीयति, -यितुम्, to act
like a wise man; A. to claim wisdom for one's self,
pretend to it.

2. कवीय, अस्, अम्, m. n. the bit of a bridle or the
reins; [cf. कविय.]

कवीयस्, आन्, असी, अस्, Ved. (comparative for कवि-
तर), wiser.

कव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. a wise, intelligent man;
(अस्), m. a class of manes; N. of one of the seven
sages of the fourth Manvantara; (अम्), n. the quali-
ties or the actions of a sage; ‘what must be offered
to sages,’ an oblation or offering of food to deceased
ancestors; (generally connected with हव्य.)
—क-
व्य-ता, f., Ved. the qualities or the actions or the
state of a sage, wisdom.
—कव्य-वाड or कव्य-
वाल, अस्, m. (formed fr. कव्य-वाह्), a class of
manes or deified ancestors.
—कव्य-वाह्, ट्, ट्, ट्, or
कव्य-वाहन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. an offering to sages,
what must be offered or what belongs to them; (अस्),
m. fire; an epithet of Śiva; (the word is formed
like हव्य-वाहन.)

काव्य काव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. कवि), endowed
with the qualities of a sage or poet, descended or
coming from a sage; prophetic, inspired, poetical; a
particular order of manes; a patronymic of Uśanas; (आस्),
m. pl. the descendants of Kavi; (आ), f. understanding,
intelligence; a female fiend [cf. पूतना]; (अम्), n.
wisdom, intelligence; prophetic inspiration; high
power and art; intellect, knowledge (often used in
pl.); a poem, poetical composition, a work of poetic
art; term for the first tetrastich in the metre Ṣaṭ-
pada; happiness, welfare.
—काव्य-कल्प-लता, f.
title of a work on artificial poems.
—काव्यकल्प-
लता-वृत्ति, इस्, f. a commentary by Amara-candra on
the last work.
—काव्यकल्पलतावृत्ति-परिमल,
a commentary on the preceding work.
—काव्य-
काम-धेनु, उस्, f. title of a commentary by Vopa-
deva on his work called Kavi-kalpadruma.
—काव्य-
चन्द्रिका, f. title of a work on artificial poems by
Kavi-candra; another work on the same subject by
Nyāyavāgīśa.
—काव्य-चौर, अस्, m. a robber of
other poems, a plagiarist.
—काव्य-ता, f. or काव्य-
त्व, अम्, n. the condition of a poetical composition.
—काव्य-देवी, f., N. of a princess, who erected a
[]
statue of Śiva, called Kāvyadevīśvara.
—काव्य-प्र-
काश or काव्य-प्रदीप, अस्, m. title of a work on
artificial poems by Mammaṭa.
—काव्य-मीमांसक,
अस्, m. a poetaster, a rhetorician.
—काव्य-रसिक,
अस्, आ, अम्, one who has a taste for poetical composi-
tions.
—काव्य-राक्षस, अम्, n. title of an artificial
poem.
—काव्य-शास्त्र, अम्, n. title of a small work
on poetics.
—काव्य-सुधा, f. title of a commentary
on a work on artificial poems.
—काव्य-हास्य, अम्,
n. a farce.
—काव्यादर्श (˚य-आद्˚), अस्, m. a work
on poetics by Daṇḍin.
—काव्यालङ्कार-वृत्ति, इस्,
f. a work on poetics by Vāmana.
—काव्याष्टक
(˚य-अष्˚), अम्, n. title of a work of Sūrya.
कविञ्जुक कविञ्जुक, अस्, m. a kind of bird.
कवूल कवूल (in astrol.) = Arabic قبول
कवेल कवेल, अम्, n. a lotus; [cf. कवार.]
कवोष्ण कवोष्ण. See under 1. कव.

कावचिक कावचिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कवच),
relating to armour, armorial; (अम्), n. a multitude
of men in armour.
कावटिका, f. a district of 200 Grāmas.

कावरुक कावरुक, अस्, ई, अम्, fearful; hen-
pecked; (अस्), m. an owl; (a wrong form for काक-
रुक or काकरूक ?).

कावषेय, अस्, m. a patronymic of Tura in the
Brāhmaṇas.

काविराज् का-विराज्, ट्, f. a metre consisting
of 9 + 12 + 9 syllables.

कावृक का-वृक, अस्, m., N. of several birds;
a gallinaceous fowl (= कुक्कुट, कृकवाकु); the
ruddy goose, Anas Casaca (= कोक); a small singing
bird, Loxia Philippensis.

कावेर कावेर, अम्, n. saffron, Crocus Sa-
tivus; (ई), f. turmeric; a courtezan, a harlot; N. of
a river in the Dekhan (according to a legend in the
Hari-vaṃśa, a daughter of Yuvanāśva and wife of Jahnu,
who by her father's curse was changed from one half
of the Gaṅgā into the river Kāverī, therefore also
called Ardha-gaṅgā or Ardha-jāhnavī).
कावेरक, अस्, m. a patronymic of Rajata-nābhi.
कावेरिका, f., N. of a river, = कावेरी.
कवयितृ = कवि, (Kumāra-s. II. 17, Malli-nātha.)
